title: Exact finite Čech augmentation for module sheaves
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, let $p:Z\to Y$ be finite and surjective [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism], and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For the fibre products $Z_q=Z^{\times_Y(q+1)}$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and projections $p_q:Z_q\to Y$, the augmented alternating Čech complex of $\Lambda_Y$-module sheaves $0\to F\to (p_0)_*p_0^{-1}F\to (p_1)_*p_1^{-1}F\to\cdots$ is exact in $\operatorname{Mod}(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$. The construction is natural in $F$ and in morphisms of finite surjective covers.
